isolation: bwrap mount namespace; only /usr, /etc, /proc, /dev, /sys, validation checkout, repository and Rust/Node tools are mounted
temporaryDirectory: private /tmp with validation worktree mounted explicitly
diagnosticFontDirectories: repository output directories with font or arial in the name are masked, except the empty Fontconfig cache/config directory
testFixtures: Tests may explicitly load repository license-checked fixtures; system/private fonts are not available.
